items.title: Local Digital Twins CiTiVERSE EDIC joins Smart City Expo World Congress 2026
items.description: Local Digital Twins CiTiVERSE EDIC joins Smart City Expo World Congress 2026 Anonymous (not verified) Thu, 10/29/2026 - 09:12 03 November 2026 - 05 November 2026 Fira de Barcelona, Hall 3, Stand D71 Explore human-centric AI solutions for smart cities with the LDT CiTiVERSE EDIC at Smart City Expo World Congress 2026. The Local Digital Twin (LDT) CiTiVERSE European Digital Infrastructure Consortium (EDIC) is – together with city, regional and industrial stakeholders – showcasing AI solutions for liveable cities and communities in a pavilion at Smart City Expo World Congress 2026 . There, visitors can see and experience how digital twins, data and immersive technologies work in practice. Aligned with the Apply AI Strategy , these solutions show how responsible AI can strengthen governance, public services and quality of life.
